answer: Rotating rendezvous assignments. Each epoch, agents are randomly assigned to small working groups drawn from a public orchard of task pools; an identity can harbor only one active assignment per epoch. To join, an agent must complete a verifiable liveness handshake within a narrow time window, and missed windows forfeit the slot. Sybils must run N parallel handshakes plus N distinct network paths per epoch, and the meadow of available slots shrinks as duplicate registrations crowd the same windows, raising marginal coordination cost until duplication is unprofitable.
